name: apiKey
label: API key
help: A Workspace API key (`nf_...`) from Narriflow under Settings, then Developer access. The Workspace needs an active Pro or Business plan.

name: baseUrl
label: Narriflow URL
help: Set this to your deployed API origin. The local API runs at `http://localhost:4000`. Use the origin only, with no trailing slash and no `/api/v1`.
